intent: Mrs. Dempsey is still warm, and that destroys the lie I am trying to tell myself that I only put down a monster. Her wedding ring is bent into her swollen hand, and I remember seeing her water the roses across the road. I need to know whether infected people are medically alive, whether anyone has ever recovered, and how I am supposed to move a contaminated body when no police or ambulance is coming.
emotion: panicked, unsettled, exhausted, trying to reason through the next practical step
